critical_code_review_comments: server.py now at 4405 lines — Schoolgram + AI endpoints should ideally move to /app/backend/routers/schoolgram.py and /app/backend/routers/ai.py (file-size guideline >700 lines).

GET /api/schoolgram/class/{cid} always exposes stories+highlights to any authenticated user; that matches the spec ('everyone logged-in can view'), just confirm dscope isolation if multi-school is ever enabled (currently _assert_manage does not re-check dscope).

/api/schoolgram/class/{cid}/story: creator user does not need to belong to the same kelas as cid; only can_manage check — fine for super_admin + ketua_kelas, but a ketua_kelas could POST to their own cid even if they moved kelas (data integrity risk if user.kelas drifts).
AI endpoints have no rate-limiting/quota; a single siswa could spam /ai/chat and burn EMERGENT_LLM_KEY credits.
/ai/quiz-generate string-parses JSON out of markdown fences — fragile; consider using model structured output or a stricter JSON extractor.
Frontend DarkMode uses localStorage key 'theme-dark' (not 'ws-dark' as the request suggested) — just a note so the main agent doesn't document the wrong key.
